Chapter 6914: One Costly Mistake

Chapter 6914: One Costly Mistake

The vile lifeform was transported outside of the primeval realm. It dispersed into countless drops and attached to the members of the alliance.

“Ahh!” Controller and the others couldn’t dodge this forceful transformation. They used their immortal dao to no avail.

“Crackle!” The expelled tribulations surged towards the lifeform. However, they stopped since the victims didn’t violate the rule in this scenario. They were born from the high heaven’s will, not created by someone else.

These tribulations stopped and became chaotic, no longer having a target.

“Primeval Fusion!” Guangmai’s body disintegrated into a bloody mist. He did it of his own volition to become one with Stygian’s dark power in the form of a maelstrom located in the primeval realm.

He absorbed the resplendent light and dark power at the same time. Naturally, those in Stygian who were connected through Dark Light couldn’t escape.

The maelstrom crushed them down before they could scream. The vile lifeform also took in the tribulations and headed for the maelstrom.

The resplendent maelstrom seemingly opened like a gaping jaw, ready to devour the incoming ocean of blood and tribulations.

Only the twenty-five immortals survived, including the Controller’s group. They summoned the treasures, struggling instead of being reduced to blood.

This wasn’t effective since the devouring effect came innately due to the pact, not an external attack. Since Guangmai broke his body down first and devoured himself, those connected to him couldn’t escape the same fate.

“Noo!” Mirage and the other nineteen grand immortals fell first, disintegrated into blood.

“Damn you!” Immortal Devourer let out one last curse before falling.

“One costly mistake.” Controller watched Devouring Lord and God Messenger die first before lamenting his faith. He gave up on struggling.

He was Mang’s strategist and provided plans all this time, allowing the alliance to thrive and survive. Unfortunately, he fell to greed and made the wrong choice.

“Pop!” He, the final survivor, became one with the bloody ocean.

The process was fast and thorough, putting an end to Devouring Alliance. The victims extended beyond just top cultivators.

Due to Gu Chun’s rules, life prospered in Stygian due to a lack of lawless devouring. Alas, all of them became Guangmai’s food. The only survivors were Immortal Emperor Gu Chun and Skyshroud.

Meanwhile, spectators in Golden Lamp nearly fainted upon watching the terrible devouring of their world.

The maelstrom continued to absorb the bloody ocean and tribulations, giving birth to a new abomination under Guangmai’s guidance.

Finally, a gigantic being of pure evil and terror stood within the primeval realm.
